value.rationale: The internal vanishing-density/conductivity bottleneck is a canonical failure mode for weighted Poincaré coercivity. A sharp critical window in which the vanishing exponent changes on 1/log(1/epsilon) scale determines quantitative finite-parameter stability, and the explicit normalized eigenfunction and energy distribution identify where the low mode and its dissipation concentrate. This is a motivated full asymptotic classification of a natural singular regime, not an arbitrary numeric slice; the proof also establishes a general mass-resistance quantitative principle.
